```{r boxplotComparison, echo = FALSE, fig.align = 'center', fig.width = 16, fig.height = 8}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Force transaction labels to track our consistent color profile
all_unique_labels <- sort(unique(raw_data$label))
num_labels <- length(all_unique_labels)

# We use run_id for fill color here to compare runs directly
unique_runs <- sort(unique(raw_data$run_id))
set.seed(42)
run_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(unique_runs)), unique_runs)

box_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = all_unique_labels))

# ============================================================
# DYNAMIC WIDTH CALCULATION
# - Allocates a base pixel width per transaction group
# ============================================================
# Count transactions and unique runs per transaction to judge clusters
num_transactions <- length(all_unique_labels)
num_of_runs <- length(unique_runs)

# Allocate roughly 60px per transaction label cluster, plus 200px for margins/legends
# Minimum canvas width restricted to 1000px so it spans small data nicely
dynamic_width <- max(1000, (num_transactions * num_of_runs * 25) + 200)

# Create the Box Plot
box_plot <- ggplot(box_data, aes(x = label, y = elapsed, fill = run_id)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1, outlier.size = 1, width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = run_colors) +
  labs(title = "Response Time Distribution Comparison",
       x = "Transaction Label",
       y = "Response Time (ms)",
       fill = "Run ID") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Convert to Plotly, setting the dynamic width here
box_plotly <- ggplotly(box_plot, height = 550, width = dynamic_width) %>%
  layout(
    margin = list(l = 60, r = 40, b = 100, t = 60),
    xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE),
    boxmode = "group" # Crucial: groups the runs side-by-side per transaction label
  ) %>%
  config(
    responsive = FALSE, # Set to FALSE so Plotly doesn't shrink back down to the screen size
    displayModeBar = TRUE,
    toImageButtonOptions = list(
      format = "png",
      filename = paste0("Boxplot_Distribution_", Sys.Date()),
      height = 550,
      width = dynamic_width
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# HORIZONTAL SCROLL CONTAINER
# - Changed 'overflow: hidden' to 'overflow-x: auto'
# - Changed 'overflow-y: hidden' to prevent vertical jumpiness
# ============================================================
htmltools::tagList(
  
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
    box_plotly
  ),
  render_observation_panel(
    chart_id = "chart_boxPlotComparison"
  )
)
```
